why: a rampart finishes at 1 hit and is gone at its first decay unless a body raises it, and a rampart or road site never holds the site budget a site that pays waits on: main (0c7ff9ad) lost its last rampart at t66.4k, and its RCL5 extension sites waited from t54.1k to t57.5k behind five road sites (#831). A level's payback sites draw the stock under the reserve: main (28df8197) held four RCL5 extensions and a tower unbuilt from t52.4k past t70k, a paying site waiting 17.6k ticks, with 10–20k stored (#832)
